title: Keep matching items
summary: Haskell: Keep matching items. Raise the limit to 9.
introduction: filter keeps items that pass a true-or-false test. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
The test keeps 8 and 9 and discards 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The test must return Bool, not a number.
